title: Run 5km from 100m
progression_logic: Start with 100m easy run + walk recovery. Add 50-150m total running per session when breathing recovers and no pain. Deload every 4th week. Goal is consistent time on feet before speed.

title: Bench press 20kg to 50kg
progression_logic: Train bench 2-3 times/week. Use 3x5-8 at RPE 6-8. Add 1.25-2.5kg only after completing all sets twice with good form; add rows, triceps, shoulder mobility and rest.

title: First push-up
progression_logic: Start wall/incline push-ups, then lower incline gradually. Add negatives and plank holds. Test floor push-up only when incline reps are smooth.

title: First pull-up
progression_logic: Use dead hangs, scap pulls, band-assisted reps, negatives and rows. Reduce assistance slowly. Stop before elbow/shoulder pain.

title: Safe weight loss starter
progression_logic: Use small calorie deficit, high fiber, whole foods, protein adequacy, steps and strength training. Avoid crash diets; track energy, sleep and mood.

title: Pregnancy walking consistency
progression_logic: If cleared, accumulate moderate walking in short bouts. Stop for warning symptoms and adapt heat, terrain and fatigue.

title: Postpartum return to core
progression_logic: Start breath/pelvic-floor coordination and walking after clearance. Progress to dead bugs, bridges and carries only if no symptoms.

title: Child active play habit
progression_logic: Use daily enjoyable play, games, climbing/running/jumping and family walks. Avoid body-shaming and fatigue punishment.

title: Teen strength technique
progression_logic: Build skill with light loads, supervised technique and gradual volume. No max lifts, no supplement prompts, no ego lifting.

title: Advanced conditioning block
progression_logic: Only for advanced adults. Alternate high and low stress days, cap RPE, monitor sleep, soreness and performance; deload if recovery drops.
